newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP confirms sale of 3.05 pct of Suez.
newsitem.headline: BNP confirms sale of 3.05 pct of Suez.

text.p: French bank Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) confirmed on Friday that it had sold its 3.05 percent stake in Cie de Suez.
BNP had no comment, however, on the buyer, a bank spokesman told Reuters.
The Les Echos newspaper said on Friday that Groupe Bruxelles Lambert, controlled by Albert Frere, had bought a 3.05 percent stake in Suez.
The transaction made GBL nearly the biggest shareholder in the merged group Suez-Lyonnaise des Eaux, almost equal to Credit Agricole, with a 7.22 percent stake while the bank will have 7.6 percent.
Prior to the sale, BNP held five percent of Suez.

The French stock market's association SBF said on Wednesday that a block of five million Suez shares, or 3.05 percent of the capital, had been traded off-market after close on Tuesday at a price of 285 francs per share or a total of 1.43 billion francs.
